_note: T1.5 graphics packs of Phantasie II. II had no DOS or Amiga port; its art comes from the Atari ST (user s71), the default (D2-014: the ST fill patterns are shown), or from the Apple II (s158, the Memorial Set's II; shapes and the title picture only). default_order keeps the ST first; with only the Apple II files present the Apple II pack is the default.
